description: NASA'S Armstrong Flight Research Center in Edwards, California, is testing a scale-model wing designed to improve laminar flow, reducing drag and lowering fuel costs for future commercial aircraft. The NASA-designed, 40-inch Crossflow Attenuated Natural Laminar Flow (CATNLF) wing model is attached to the underside of one of the agency's F-15B research
